source.post_text:
Sinatra once told the story of eating at a restaurant and Don Rickles asked if he could come by his table to impress his date and prove he knows him.

A few minutes later Frank walks up and says hey Don how are you? 

Rickles said hey Frank, do you mind we’re eating.

replies.text: I've heard that story. Sinatra really cracked up when this happened.
replies.author: @rickdanna4719

replies.text: Rickles always had the perfect zinger ready.
replies.author: decoy

replies.text: Don Rickles was hilarious!  I miss him.
replies.author: @JeffGil27225591

decoy_rationale: The slightly polished phrasing and word choice 'zinger' stand out as more writerly than the plain, direct praise in the real replies.
